description: This file defines the AuthManager class, which manages authentication state, token storage, login, logout, session locking/unlocking, and token refresh logic for an Android app. It interacts with session repository, token store, and handles network operations abstractly.

classes.name: AuthManager
classes.description: Core class managing authentication state, token persistence, login, logout, lock/unlock, and token refresh operations.

methods.name: authStateFlow
methods.description: Returns a flow observing authentication state changes.

methods.name: currentState
methods.description: Returns the current authentication state snapshot.

methods.name: initializeFromStorage
methods.description: Loads persisted session tokens into memory at app startup, setting state to locked if tokens exist.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login by exchanging credentials for tokens, then persists tokens and sets state to unlocked.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Locks the current session, keeping tokens persisted but requiring re-authentication.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the session after successful biometric or device credential verification.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears stored tokens and sets session state to logged out.

methods.name: getAccessTokenIfUnlocked
methods.description: Retrieves the access token if the session is unlocked.

methods.name: ensureFreshAccessToken
methods.description: Ensures a valid, non-expired access token, refreshing if necessary.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create AuthManager with default dependencies.

methods.name: createForTesting
methods.description: Factory method to create AuthManager with injected dependencies for testing.
